rules.statement: A minor holding a general power of attorney for his principal abroad is competent to act as his agent for the limited purposes mentioned in section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: The question here is really this,-May not a minor holding the general powers of attorney for his principal abroad, which is indicated in section 25 (6) of the Civil Procedure Code, act as a recognized agent for the limited powers mentioned in section 24 ? The said Somasundaram Chetty holds such a power; then why should he be not allowed to appear and act as the recognized agent of his principal ?
